---
title: "Ask AREE"
subtitle: "Ask questions about AREE's evidence in plain language"
toc: false
css: ask/ask.css
---

Ask about AREE's registered studies, genes, candidate biomarkers and how to read
them. Claude answers by querying AREE's published tables, and cites the study behind
each claim. Open **How this answer was found** under an answer to see every query
it ran and exactly what came back.

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
**How to read these answers.** AREE's evidence records are statistical associations
from individual studies. A significant result or a high candidate score is not a
validated biomarker and does not establish causation. A language model can also
misread a table, so check any claim you rely on against the cited study on the
[Explore page](explore.qmd) before using it.
:::

Questions are sent to AREE's chat service and to Anthropic's Claude API to be
answered, so don't include personal or confidential information. There is a limit
on questions per hour and per day. How the service works, and what it costs to run,
is described in [Ask AREE chat service](ask_aree.md).
